{
  "phoneNote": "The aquatic styling is memorable, but the timetable-led hero gives more prominence to the hour than to the children's swimming school.",
  "desktopNote": "The oversized headline consumes most of the first screen, pushing the school description down and leaving the pool photograph barely visible.",

    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 2,
    "imagery": 2,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Reduce the hero headline substantially, especially on desktop, and establish children's swimming lessons as the primary message, with location and timetable beneath it.",
    "Bring the pool photograph into the desktop hero beside the text, and shorten the phone hero so the image appears earlier while retaining the aquatic typography.",
    "Consolidate repeated timetable and location details into one compact information block, keep the FAQ focused on additional questions, and tighten the generous section padding."
  ]
}
